items.title: “민주당이 맘에 안 들어” “국힘은 예산도 못 따내”…대구시장은 누가 될까 - 한겨레

summaries.ko: 대구시장 선거가 김부겸 민주당 후보와 보수 결집 및 경제 회복을 내세운 추경호 국힘 후보의 맞대결로 압축된 가운데, 추 후보는 과거 논란이 약점으로 작용하고 김 후보는 정부와의 협력을 통한 대구 발전을 강조하며 격전이 예상된다.
summaries.en: The Daegu mayoral election has narrowed down to a head-to-head race between Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum and People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho, who advocates for conservative unity and economic revival, with Choo facing weaknesses due to past controversies while Kim emphasizes Daegu's development through cooperation with the government, signaling an intense battle.
summaries.zh: 随着大邱市长选举锁定为民主党候选人金富谦和推崇保守团结与经济复苏的国民力量党候选人秋庆镐之间的正面交锋，秋候选人因过去的争议面临弱点，而金候选人则强调通过与政府合作促进大邱发展，预示着一场激烈的选战。

summaries.en: It has been officially confirmed that the controversy over domestic regulations concerning Coupang Chairman Kim Beom-seok is expanding beyond U.S.-Korea trade issues to affect security talks, posing a diplomatic and security threat.
